_comment: Every secret the foundation's services use. Names and handling only, never values. `generate` says how scripts/secrets.py makes a new value: hex32 and b64key are random, `provided` means an outside party issues it and someone pastes it in. `envs` limits a secret to some of the template environments: local, dev, prod (any other goes by its SHAPE). Modules list theirs in <module>/secrets.json. upstream U8: the foundation could publish this per repo.

secrets.name: POSTGRES_PASSWORD
secrets.rotate: ALTER ROLE t10 PASSWORD …, change the value, then roll the services that connect as t10.

secrets.name: AUTH_ADMIN_PASSWORD
secrets.rotate: Used once at bootstrap. Change the admin's password in the app afterwards.

secrets.name: AUTH_TOTP_KEY
secrets.rotate: Not rotatable without re-enrolling every TOTP. Generate once.

secrets.name: AUTH_SIGNING_KEY_CURRENT
secrets.rotate: authctl gen-key, publish as AUTH_SIGNING_KEY_NEXT, wait one token lifetime, promote to CURRENT. Dev mode makes its own. The value is PEM: store it on one line in double quotes, with each newline written as \n.

secrets.name: AUTH_SIGNING_KEY_NEXT
secrets.rotate: Set only during a signing key rotation.

secrets.name: AGENT_TI_SECRET
secrets.rotate: authctl service-rotate --name=agent-ti, roll agent-ti, then authctl service-finish.

secrets.name: WORKBENCH_CLIENT_SECRET
secrets.rotate: Change, re-render clients.yaml, roll auth-server and workbench together. Sign-in fails briefly.

secrets.name: WORKBENCH_SESSION_KEY
secrets.rotate: Change and roll workbench. Everyone signs in again.

secrets.name: MODEL_KEY
secrets.rotate: Not rotatable yet: stored tenant model keys become unreadable. Back it up with the agent_control database.

secrets.name: GATEWAY_API_KEY
secrets.rotate: Change on both sides together, then roll.

secrets.name: AUDIT_CONSOLE_KEY
secrets.rotate: Change on all sides, then roll.

secrets.name: LLM_API_KEY
secrets.rotate: Add a new key at the provider, roll ai-gateway-llm, revoke the old one.
